projects_meta_description: Public software and homelab projects built and maintained by Ting.
projects_intro: A growing collection of tools I build for real needs. I only list services that are publicly available and ready to be used.
project_setlist_description: A self-hosted VTuber karaoke search index. Setlist discovers public YouTube archives, extracts timestamped song lists from comments, and creates searchable links that open at the exact performance.
project_setlist_feature_search: Fast song search with channel, content type, and date filters
project_setlist_feature_links: Timestamp-aware YouTube links to each performance
project_setlist_feature_languages: English, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese interface
projects_more_heading: More things are being tested privately.
projects_more_body: Only one service is public for now. New projects will appear here when they are useful, stable enough, and ready for other people.
profile_meta_description: Software engineer, system architect, and homelab enthusiast in Hong Kong.
profile_intro: I work across software, infrastructure, automation, and self-hosted systems—usually at the point where a reliable platform makes a useful tool possible.
profile_currently_body: Running a Proxmox VE homelab, researching AI / LLM / agents, experimenting with locally deployed models, and building small tools that remove friction.
profile_about_heading: A builder across the whole stack.
profile_about_p1: I am a software engineer in Hong Kong, working primarily on programming, infrastructure, automation, self-hosted services, and AI-assisted tools.
profile_about_p2: My homelab runs on Proxmox VE, with OPNsense segmenting a multi-VLAN network, a reverse proxy as the public entry point, and Docker hosting services. Parts of the platform are managed with infrastructure as code and automated deployment.
profile_about_p3: Recently, I have been exploring where AI is genuinely useful: using LLMs to build tools and letting supervised agents help operate the homelab, while keeping the system understandable and under human control.
profile_focus_platform_desc: Designing infrastructure that stays understandable, observable, and easy to recover.
profile_focus_product_desc: Building useful interfaces and services from backend contracts to the final interaction.
profile_focus_ai_desc: Working with local models and state-of-the-art cloud models—including Claude, ChatGPT, Kimi, and GLM—and applying supervised agents to practical, measurable work.
profile_portfolio_heading: Built for a real question, then opened to everyone.
profile_portfolio_body: Setlist is the first public service from my homelab. It combines a search product, a resilient data pipeline, and a secure self-hosted deployment.
profile_stack_subtitle: Tools I use to build, ship, and operate systems.
